1. (Currently Amended) A system (100) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- an image interface (120) for obtaining the medical image (042);
- a user interface subsystem (140) for enabling a user to apply one or more graphical elements (310) to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, wherein the application data is automatically processed by the system to identify specific anatomical structures or pathological findings marked by the graphical elements; and
- a reporting subsystem (180) for:
i) accessing a medical database (060) comprising medical information items (062-066) which each represent medical reference information (400-414) that is specific to the identified anatomical structures or pathological findings,
ii) retrieving a medical information item (062) from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item through a technical mapping that correlates specific graphical element types, positions, and marked structures to corresponding medical reference information, and
iii) generating a report (182) that includes the retrieved medical reference information integrated with the measurement data or structural identification data derived from the graphical elements.

2. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the medical information item (062) is associated with a codified version of the medical reference information (420), and wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information in generating the report (182) by automatically encoding the medical reference information according to standardized medical coding systems.

3. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein:
- the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for displaying the medical reference information as a selectable graphical element (400-414) to the user based on the specific anatomical structures or pathological findings identified by the marked graphical elements, and
- the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information (420) in generating the report (182) based on the user selecting the selectable graphical element, wherein the selection triggers automated retrieval and encoding of corresponding medical reference data.

4. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using a macro (080) to generate the codified version of the medical reference information (420) from the medical reference information (400-414), wherein the macro is configured to automatically process and encode the medical reference information based on the specific graphical elements applied to the medical image.

5. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 4, wherein the medical information item (062) comprises the macro (080) or a reference to the macro.

6. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the medical information items (062-066) are cross-referenced via hyperlinks, and wherein the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for enabling the user to interactively browse to another medical information item by selecting a hyperlink in the selectable graphical element (410-414), wherein the hyperlinks are automatically generated based on the association data linking graphical elements to medical information items.

7. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the selectable graphical element is a selectable overlay (410, 412), and wherein the user interface subsystem is arranged for displaying the medical reference information in the form of text (410, 412) or graphics (414) in the selectable overlay, wherein the overlay is automatically positioned and populated based on the location and type of graphical elements applied to the medical image.

8. (Currently Amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) provide a measurement tool for enabling the user to perform a measurement on the medical image (042) using the user interface subsystem, and wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by measurement data (312) representing the measurement, wherein the measurement data is automatically correlated to medical reference information items through the technical mapping of measurement types and values to corresponding medical conditions or findings.

9. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 8, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the measurement data (312) in generating the report (182).

10. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by a plurality of rules each linking a respective one of the one or more graphical elements (310) to a respective one of the medical information items (062-066).

11. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the application data represents one or more of the group of:
- a type of the one or more graphical elements (310);
- a position of the one or more graphical elements in the medical image; and
- an image structure (044) marked by the one or more graphical elements.

12. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) comprise one or more of the group of: a marker, an annotation and a measurement tool (310).

13. (Previously presented) Workstation or imaging apparatus comprising the system according to claim 1.

14. (Currently Amended) A method (200) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- obtaining (210) the medical image;
- enabling (220) a user to apply one or more graphical elements to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, wherein the application data is automatically processed to identify specific anatomical structures or pathological findings marked by the graphical elements;
- accessing (230) a medical database comprising medical information items which each represent medical reference information that is specific to identified anatomical structures or pathological findings;
- retrieving (240) a medical information item from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item through a technical mapping that correlates specific graphical element types, positions, and marked structures to corresponding medical reference information, and
- generating (250) a report based on the medical information item, wherein the report includes the retrieved medical reference information integrated with measurement data or structural identification data derived from the graphical elements.

15. (Currently Amended) A __non-transitory__ computer program product (270) comprising instructions for causing a processor system to perform the method according to claim 14.
